corrections.why: The statewide list prints 'BLL-41101 gfc-326' as codes on the entry and does not call them register numbers. The list flags NHLR-registered towers with 'nhlr' (for example Mathis Lookout, which matches the register's Mathis Fire Tower, US 705, GA 8), and this entry has no such flag. The register's Georgia list has no Butler.

notes_for_editor: Two web searches, the statewide list, the Forest Lookouts Georgia index, the NHLR Georgia list and the former-sites register were checked. No Forest Lookouts page for this tower could be opened (butler.html returns 404), so the index is the only second source. The codes BLL-41101 and gfc-326 are not explained anywhere we read; BLL-numbers also appear on other entries (Monticello BLL-41100, Chattahoochee BLL-41098) and gfc-numbers look like Forestry Commission numbers, but neither is confirmed. The correction to 'registers' is a proposal for the editor to confirm before the value is changed. Beulah Lookout Tower (GA010, 653 ft, also Taylor County) is a different entry, about 16 km away, and was not used. Suggested check: ask the Georgia Forestry Commission Taylor County office about the tower and its gfc-326 number.
